# Chikn Game Assets model context

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Roost2D/chikn-game-assets
Quick start: /quick-start
Distribution: /distribution
Rights: /rights

Chikn, Roostr, and FarmLand visual artwork is protected Chikn content under the repository identifier CHIKN-COMMUNITY-NONCOMMERCIAL. It records Chikn's existing community permission and does not create a Roost2D licence or sublicense. Rig/animation metadata, manifests, schemas, code, and docs are separate Apache-2.0 project material. Files in rights-manifest excludedPaths, including eggorithm.png, are not Chikn property and are not published.

The npm runtime contains no images. Games host an immutable runtime ZIP and supply its base URL explicitly. The sources ZIP is for original classified inputs and audits.
